facts.fact: The ATU Secretary-General's circular of 2026-06-04 states that the Federal Government of Nigeria accepted to host the 7th ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries in Abuja on 23-24 July 2026, with an Administrative Council special session (16-17 July) and a regional preparatory meeting for ITU PP-26 (18 July) before it; the meeting is scheduled, not yet held, at the document's date.
